This clears ALL plugin-owned data: bank registry, attempt log, wrongbook actions/reasons, actions, mock records, AI queue/usage/explain history, import mappings, smart views, drafts.

Untouched: SiYuan notebooks and question blocks, AI key (host secret store). Already-sent AI data cannot be recalled. Consider exporting a backup first.
